name: katta
description: Katta — internal tools suite: Gear Wall, Admissions CRM, Onboarding Academy, Katta Knowledge and portfolio. Vanilla front-ends over a zero-dependency Node API.

scripts.health: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:4173/api/health').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log(JSON.stringify(d,null,2))).catch(()=>console.log('server is not running — start it with: npm run dev'))"
scripts.reset: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('database cleared — apps will re-seed on next load')"
